summary: Assess control design, test evidence, document deficiencies, and plan remediation. Explore this practical five-day internal controls training course.
lede: Internal control training helps professionals assess whether controls address process risks and operate as intended. For control owners, risk and compliance practitioners, and internal auditors, it covers mapping risks to controls, evaluating design, defining test populations, and reviewing evidence. Participants also practice documenting exceptions, analyzing root causes, and tracking corrective actions using process maps, control matrices, test plans, and remediation trackers.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who document, operate, test, review, or improve controls within business processes. It suits intermediate-level roles that need to support conclusions with evidence and coordinate remediation with process owners.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with business processes, control responsibilities, risk or compliance work, or internal audit is expected. No programming is required; exercises use spreadsheets and word-processing tools.
